concepts.name: small transformer
concepts.definition: A small transformer that uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training.

concepts.name: self attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism used by a small transformer to process text.

concepts.name: text
concepts.definition: The input data processed by self-attention.

concepts.name: backpropagation
concepts.definition: A mechanism used by a small transformer to improve its predictions during training.

concepts.name: prediction
concepts.definition: The outputs of a small transformer that are improved during training via backpropagation.

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: The context in which a small transformer uses self-attention and backpropagation.

concepts.name: regularization
concepts.definition: A technique applied to machine learning models.

concepts.name: generalization beyond training example
concepts.definition: The ability of a model to perform well on unseen data.

concepts.name: quantization
concepts.definition: a process that reduces memory requirements after training

concepts.name: retrieval augmented generation
concepts.definition: a method that lets a system use external documents when answering questions

concepts.name: memory requirement
concepts.definition: the amount of memory needed by a process

concepts.name: external document
concepts.definition: documents used to answer questions outside the model's internal knowledge

concepts.name: use of external document
concepts.definition: the act of utilizing external documents when answering questions

concepts.name: dot product operation
concepts.definition: The mathematical operation used to calculate raw attention scores between query and key vectors.

concepts.name: raw attention score
concepts.definition: Unnormalized scores derived from dot products between query and key vectors.

concepts.name: softmax function
concepts.definition: The normalization function that converts raw scores into a probability distribution.

concepts.name: normalized attention distribution
concepts.definition: The probability distribution over the input sequence resulting from softmax normalization.

concepts.name: value vector
concepts.definition: The vector representations of input tokens used to generate the final output.

concepts.name: standard self attention mechanism
concepts.definition: The core attention mechanism without additional inputs like positional encodings.

concepts.name: permutation invariant property
concepts.definition: The characteristic where the output remains unchanged regardless of token order.

concepts.name: positional encoding
concepts.definition: Information added to input embeddings to indicate the relative or absolute position of tokens within a sequence.

mention.name: self attention
mention.definition: A self-attention mechanism computes attention weights by calculating dot products between query vectors and key vectors from input embeddings.

mention.name: dot product operation
mention.definition: The mathematical operation used to calculate raw attention scores between query and key vectors.

mention.name: raw attention scores
mention.definition: Unnormalized scores derived from dot products between query and key vectors.

mention.name: softmax function
mention.definition: The normalization function that converts raw scores into a probability distribution.

mention.name: normalized attention distribution
mention.definition: The probability distribution over the input sequence resulting from softmax normalization.

mention.name: value vectors
mention.definition: The vector representations of input tokens used to generate the final output.

mention.name: standard self-attention mechanism
mention.definition: The core attention mechanism without additional inputs like positional encodings.

mention.name: permutation invariant property
mention.definition: The characteristic where the output remains unchanged regardless of token order.

mention.name: self attention
mention.definition: The core mechanism in transformers that computes relationships between tokens, inherently permutation invariant without additional context.

mention.name: positional encodings
mention.definition: Information added to input embeddings to indicate the relative or absolute position of tokens within a sequence.

mention.name: self attention
mention.definition: A mechanism within transformer models that processes input sequences by computing relationships between tokens.

mention.name: raw attention score
mention.definition: An unnormalized scalar value computed as the dot product of a query vector and a key vector.

mention.name: normalized attention distribution
mention.definition: A probability distribution over tokens derived from raw attention scores via the softmax function, summing to one.
